trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done — there is no extra task behind it. It is single-player only, with no online trophy and no DLC requirement, so one playthrough is enough. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours; the long pole is 100% completion, not the story.
steps: Finish the story (S1) and the character finales (S3).
Clear the 100% Completion checklist (S7) — it is the last big gate.
Mop up any stray trophies in S4–S6 before the platinum pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks after the first main mission in Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, which opens the game. Just play the opening; no side work is needed. PowerPyx lists it as the first story beat of the roadmap.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 2. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before this chapter ends — it is the only thing in the game that can be missed. PowerPyx and GameMapa both stress keeping a manual save at each chapter boundary because there is no mission replay.
steps: Before finishing Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter.
Finish the last Chapter 1 mission; the trophy pops as Chapter 2 opens.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 3. By now both Lucia and Jason are playable, so the remaining meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude can be started. Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary, since missions cannot be replayed.
steps: Play through Chapter 2 to its end.
Once both characters are playable, start the remaining meditation spots.
The trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 4. PowerPyx notes the story is divided into 5 chapters and takes around 60–80 hours; keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter because there is no mission replay.
steps: Play through Chapter 3 to its end.
Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary.
The trophy pops as Chapter 4 opens.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It unlocks after the final mission begins. After the story ends, free-roam continues and everything needed for the 100% checklist is still accessible, so nothing in Chapter 4 itself can lock you out of the platinum.
steps: Play through Chapter 4 to its end.
Keep a manual save before the final mission.
The trophy pops as the finale opens.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The story finale, and the only gold trophy that is hidden. It pops when the final mission ends. After it, free-roam continues, the 100% Completion entry appears under Progress > Stats, and every cleanup trophy is still reachable. PowerPyx puts the story at 60–80 hours of the roughly 200-hour platinum.
steps: Finish the final mission.
After the credits, open Progress > Stats to see the 100% Completion checklist.
Continue in free-roam for S4–S7 cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends; no extra objective is needed. Story missions have no gold medals and cannot be replayed, so enjoy the mission itself — the trophy is guaranteed on completion.
steps: Play the story mission Breakfast Run.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist. It pops when the mission ends. Heist missions are story beats, not the separate bank-vault robberies that Maximum Withdrawal counts, so do not confuse the two.
steps: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for the mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends. Like every story mission, it cannot be missed and cannot be replayed, so a manual save before it is the only safety net if you want to re-experience it.
steps: Play the story mission Child's Play.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for the mission Headliners. It pops when the mission ends. The name is stylised with no vowel, exactly as PlayStation lists it.
steps: Play the story mission Headliners.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown. It pops when the mission ends. VCIA is the airport; the unrelated trophy Catch Me If You Can also happens there, but it is a separate free-roam stunt, not this mission.
steps: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops when the mission ends. This is the last of the six named story-mission trophies; after it, the remaining story trophies are the chapter completions and the finale.
steps: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the last big gate before the platinum. PowerPyx and GameMapa agree it is closer to 60% true completion: you need 200 of 277 base vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, and every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. After the story, open Progress > Stats to see the checklist.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist: 200 vehicles, 100 animals studied, 70 challenges, 15 card sets, all robberies and ranges.
The trophy pops at 100%; the platinum follows once the last stray trophy lands.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Push Square reports there are 397 stunts in the game, so you need a little over half of them. Stunts are the jumps and air tricks scattered across Leonida; use fast cars and the stunt ramps, and track the count in Progress > Stats. It comes naturally across a full playthrough plus cleanup.
steps: Hit stunt jumps and ramps as you travel; every landing counts.
Check the running total under Progress > Stats.
Sweep the remaining stunt spots in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The activities are the side pursuits across Leonida — racing, fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races, and the rest. One try of each is enough; you do not need to win or gold them for this trophy. PowerPyx lists the activities as part of the S4 cleanup.
steps: Open the activities list and try one of each type.
A single attempt of each counts — no win needed.
The trophy pops after the ninth type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. The Games Wiki notes there are 12 ranges; each holds several challenges. Gold each one — silver or bronze does not count. Take your time, learn each range's pattern, and use the best weapon the range offers.
steps: Visit all 12 shooting ranges across Leonida.
Gold every challenge in each range (42 total).
Replay any challenge that lands below gold until it is gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. PowerPyx lists 14 Top Fun spots; each has its own drone race. You only need one win per location, so learn each course's line, then move on. Drone races are also required for 100% completion.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun locations across Leonida.
Win one drone race at each location.
The trophy pops after the 14th win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each distinct race counts once, so winning the same race twice does not help. Mix car, bike and boat races across Leonida; the race list in the activities menu shows which you have won. Races also feed the 100% checklist.
steps: Enter races across Leonida — road, off-road and water.
Win 20 different ones; repeats do not count twice.
Check the activities menu for which races are still unwon.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival; challenge him at a fishing spot and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also counts toward Master of None. Use the best rod and bait you have, and watch the tension meter.
steps: Go fishing and find Cal's challenge.
Out-fish Cal in the challenge.
The trophy pops when you beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Arcade cabinets are found in arcades and some homes; the Games Wiki notes Bang For Your Buck is playable at home or on arcade cabinets. Any single completed game counts — you do not need a high score. This is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in an arcade or a home.
Play and complete one full arcade game.
The trophy pops at the game's end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, who is Lucia-only. Character finales unlock as the story progresses; Andy's chain is Lucia's. Finish each mission in the chain in order — the finale is the last one. PowerPyx lists the five character finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) as S3 cleanup after the story.
steps: Play as Lucia and follow Andy's mission chain.
Complete each mission in order.
The trophy pops after Andy's final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's chain is one of the five character finale chains. Play the missions in order; the finale is the last mission in his chain. The boat in the name is a hint to the finale's setting, not a separate objective.
steps: Follow Kenton's mission chain in order.
Complete each mission as it appears.
The trophy pops after Kenton's final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's chain is one of the five character finale chains. Play the missions in order; the finale is the last one. The rider in the name points to the bike-heavy finale, not a separate stunt.
steps: Follow Billy's mission chain in order.
Complete each mission as it appears.
The trophy pops after Billy's final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as purple icons, plus black icons with pink letters, as PowerPyx notes. Each strand is a short chain; finish all of one strand before it counts. GameMapa's roadmap puts this in the final cleanup step, about 10 hours, because the checklist does not require these quests.
steps: Look for purple stranger icons (and black icons with pink letters) across Leonida.
Finish a full strand — a single mission in a strand does not count.
Complete 8 strands; the trophy pops after the eighth.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's chain is one of the five character finale chains. Play the missions in order; the finale is the last one. The supply in the name is the chain's theme, not a collectible to gather.
steps: Follow Randy's mission chain in order.
Complete each mission as it appears.
The trophy pops after Randy's final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, who is Jason-only. Tyrone's chain is one of the five character finale chains. Play as Jason and follow the chain in order; the finale is the last mission. This is the last of the five character finales.
steps: Play as Jason and follow Tyrone's mission chain.
Complete each mission in order.
The trophy pops after Tyrone's final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN MISS. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — and the first one is missable. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation. Complete that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1, or it is gone. The last meditation cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. PowerPyx and KeenGamer both flag this as the only possibly missable trophy in the game.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — after Down to Earth: find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony, and meditate. Do this BEFORE leaving Chapter 1.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can play as both characters, start the remaining spots.
Meditate at each of the 18 spots across Leonida.
The trophy pops at 18 spots. Keep a manual save at each chapter boundary as a safety net.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quest is part of the 100% checklist — GameMapa notes you need every Bret quest. Find the unique animal Bret asks for, track it, and hunt it. Unlike the 100 animals you only need to study through binoculars for 100%, this one must actually be hunted.
steps: Take Bret's quest and learn which unique animal he wants.
Track the animal to its habitat.
Hunt it; the trophy pops on the kill.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game, and 100% completion needs 15 of them, so this trophy is only the start. Cards are scattered across Leonida; use the collectible map in the guides and pick up cards as you travel. A set counts when every card in it is found.
steps: Find collectible cards across Leonida.
Complete one full set — every card in that set.
Complete 3 sets; the trophy pops after the third.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app — open it at a location and scan. PowerPyx advises scanning every new vehicle and location as you travel, since 100% completion also needs 100 WAiNK locations. It is a habit trophy: scan often and it pops on its own.
steps: Open the WAiNK app at new locations and scan.
Scan every new spot as you travel the story.
The trophy pops at 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in the game and 100% completion needs 70 of them, so you can skip the nastiest ones. Challenges are the small feats across activities and the open world; the challenge list shows your progress. Pick the easy ones first, then work toward 70 for 100%.
steps: Open the challenge list and pick the easiest ones first.
Complete 50 challenges for this trophy.
Keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bring your partner along, raise your wanted level to 4 stars, then break line of sight and escape together. Use a fast car, break the cops' line of sight, and stay hidden until the stars clear. The partner must be with you when the heat drops.
steps: Bring your partner and raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Escape together — break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.
The trophy pops when the wanted level is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. The trick is the opposite of escaping: you must KEEP the wanted level the whole time. Rob a shop, move straight to the next, and rob it before the heat dies down. Do all three in one run with your partner beside you.
steps: Bring your partner and rob a shop to gain a wanted level.
Move immediately to the next shop and rob it while still wanted.
Rob a third shop the same way, without the wanted level ever clearing.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles count as discovered when you scan them with WAiNK or drive them. PowerPyx notes 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base vehicle models, so this trophy is halfway there. Drive everything you see and scan new models as you find them.
steps: Drive and scan every new vehicle model you see.
Use the WAiNK app to log new models.
The trophy pops at 100 vehicles; keep going to 200 for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim mode. Find a spot with at least 5 enemies grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all 5 before it ends. A busy gang shootout or a police standoff is the best place to try it.
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends.
The trophy pops on the fifth takedown in that one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. This is a free-roam stunt, not the story mission VCIA Takedown. Grab a plane at the airport and take off without following the usual departure — the trophy is about leaving on your own terms. Any aircraft at VCIA works.
steps: Go to VCIA airport in free-roam.
Get into an aircraft and take off on an unscheduled departure.
The trophy pops once you are airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks. This trophy is about getting into a Rhino tank and surviving the heat it brings — the cryptic description is the joke. Steal or commandeer a Rhino, then ride it until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy police response, so pick your moment.
steps: Find a Rhino tank.
Get in and ride it through the heat.
The trophy pops once you have survived the ride.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth robbery: get in, take the goods, and get out before anyone spots you. Move quietly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and leave before the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave and try again.
steps: Enter a jewelry store quietly.
Take the goods without being seen by staff or cameras.
Leave undetected; the trophy pops on a clean getaway.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are separate from the story's Cartel Heist. KeenGamer notes 100% completion needs 8 bank vault robberies, so this trophy is five of the eight. Each vault needs a plan and a getaway — escape after every vault for it to count.
steps: Find and rob a bank vault, then escape.
Repeat for 5 vaults; each escape counts.
Keep going to 8 vaults for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida; ambush one, crack it open, take the cash, and escape before the police box you in. A sticky ambush spot with a fast getaway car makes it easy. One clean robbery and escape is all it takes.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it, crack it open, and take the cash.
Escape the police; the trophy pops on a clean getaway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. The map fills in as you visit each area; the area list in Progress shows which are still missing. Drive, fly and boat across the whole state, including the small islands and the far corners. The last few areas are the ones players miss, so check the list before declaring it done.
steps: Travel across Leonida and let the map fill in.
Check Progress for the areas still unvisited.
Visit the last areas; the trophy pops at 52 of 52.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — all 9 gangs. Each gang runs illegal operations around Leonida; hit one operation per gang. KeenGamer notes 100% completion needs 39 Gang Operations in total, so this trophy is one per gang while the checklist wants many more. Mark each gang off as you hit it.
steps: Find an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a quiet moment trophy: go to a bar or vendor on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. No combat, no timer — just sit with the drink and the ocean. The ellipsis in the name is part of the official title.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail at a beach bar or vendor.
Enjoy the view; the trophy pops as you drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive into a vehicle showroom, then smash straight out through the glass in a car — the classic GTA showroom exit. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build speed inside, and go through it. The trophy is about the exit, not the entry.
steps: Drive a car into a vehicle showroom.
Build speed and smash out through the glass front.
The trophy pops on the exit.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at that alley and complete a game — follow through on the throw, as the description says. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so it also counts toward Master of None. One full game is enough.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling.
The trophy pops at the game's end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is a partner-activity trophy: do something with your partner that draws a crowd — a public moment together that the game counts as mass appeal. Play the partner activities and the trophy pops when the crowd moment lands. The cryptic description hides the exact trigger, so try the partner outings.
steps: Do partner activities together in public spots.
Look for a moment that draws a crowd.
The trophy pops when the mass-appeal moment lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks a count to 500 for this trophy — every meaningful choice you make in dialogue and missions adds to it. There is no single trigger; it accumulates across the whole game as you pick options. Play naturally, make choices whenever offered, and it pops by the end of a full playthrough.
steps: Make choices whenever the game offers them — dialogue and mission options.
The count climbs toward 500 across the playthrough.
The trophy pops at 500 choices.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This trophy pops when you succeed at something on your second try after failing the first. Fail an attempt at an activity or challenge, then succeed immediately on the retry. The simplest route is a short activity you can fail and retry quickly.
steps: Pick a short activity or challenge.
Fail the first attempt, then succeed on the immediate retry.
The trophy pops on the second-try success.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is the strange-encounter trophy — witness something weird in the world, the kind of odd event Leonida hides in its corners. Explore off the beaten path, especially at night and in remote spots, and the trophy pops when you stumble on the strange event.
steps: Explore remote and odd corners of Leonida, especially at night.
Look for strange events and encounters.
The trophy pops when you witness one.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A melee drive-by is attacking from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon — the bowling pun is the joke. Drive past a target and land a melee hit from the vehicle. A slow pass through a crowded sidewalk makes it easy to connect.
steps: Get in a vehicle with a melee weapon ready.
Drive past a target and land a melee hit from the moving vehicle.
The trophy pops on the hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; take them to your contacts to launder them into clean cash. The total is cumulative — every laundered dollar counts toward the $250,000. Rob often, launder often, and the trophy pops as the total crosses the line.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every shop in Leonida — clothes, weapons, cars, food, anything. It adds up fast once you start buying cars and weapons, so do not grind it specially; just play and buy what you need, and check the running total in the stats.
steps: Buy gear, clothes, cars and weapons across Leonida's shops.
The total is cumulative across all shops.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all 8 of them. Garages are bought through the property listings; each one costs money, so save up or earn it through robberies and races. Owning all 8 also gives you storage across Leonida, which helps the vehicle-collecting trophies.
steps: Save up money through robberies, races and missions.
Buy each of the 8 garage properties.
The trophy pops after the eighth purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles you find; open it near a vehicle and register it. Any 10 vehicles count — the cheap and common ones are fine. Register as you discover new models and it pairs naturally with Whip It Good.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app near a vehicle.
Register the vehicle to the app.
Register 10 vehicles; the trophy pops after the tenth.
